scoring_justification: Mechanical properties are recomputed from raw energy-strain CSV data; band gap compared to paper gold with tolerance. Full T1 recompute is feasible.

outputs.description: Raw energy–strain CSV for both phases. The checker recomputes tensile stiffnesses, cohesive energy difference, and equilibrium tension from these points.
Agent-reported mechanical properties. The checker compares these against independently computed reference values derived from step01 and the paper's hidden targets.
Electronic band gap of the C phase. The checker compares this value to the hidden reference (HSE06 band gap) within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All mechanical quantities derived from step01_energy_strain.csv must be consistent with the energy–strain data. The checker does not rely solely on the self-reported values in step02; it recomputes from step01 and cross-checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported reference values for cohesive energy difference, tensile stiffnesses, equilibrium tension, and band gap.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the paper: Section 3.3 (energy–strain, ΔE_c=1 eV, stiffness 72/46 eV/Å, F_eq=2.13 nN) and Section 3.2 (band gap 1.52 eV HSE06).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribing the values from the published article.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported numbers from the journal, traceable to specific paragraphs and figures.

steps.description: Verify CSV contains data for both R and C phases.
Recompute cohesive energy difference, tensile stiffnesses, and equilibrium tension from energy-strain data and compare to paper targets.
Check that self-reported derived properties match the values recomputed from the raw CSV within tight tolerance.
Compare reported band gap to paper gold (HSE06) within 0.1 eV.
